title: cordia glabrata
intro: Cordia glabrata, commonly known as the "Wild Apricot" or "Cordia", is a plant species that belongs to the Bignoniaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cordia glabrata include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, while also being used to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
